Turn your
hustle into
a business.
You're good at the work. Cohort 6 makes you good at the business around it: one offer, one price, one pipeline that fills itself.
Lena Marsh · sold $2.1M of freelance work, kept the receipts
Stop selling hours. We carve one productized offer out of what you already do well.
A number your landlord would respect. Anchoring, packaging, and saying it out loud without flinching.
Outreach scripts that sound like you, a pipeline in a spreadsheet, and the follow-up cadence that isn't stalking.
Onboarding, scope walls, and the Tuesday-only meeting policy. Keep the margin you just created.
Receipts, not testimonials.
“I rewrote one cold email using the week-4 script and closed two retainers in nine days.”
“Tripled my rate. Lost one client, and honestly, good riddance to that one.”
“Turned 'whatever you need' into one fixed package. Sold eleven of them in twelve weeks.”
Numbers self-reported, then spot-checked in the community. We drop any we can't verify.
Finish the six weeks. No pipeline? Full refund.
Show your homework, get your money back. Four people have asked in eleven cohorts.
